items.name: palette-from-image-ai
items.description: AI coloring palette-from-image generator for designers and pixel artists — pull a clean named palette straight from any image, no subscription or cloud upload.
items.readme:
--- ## 🎨 Overview
![status](https://img.shields.io/badge/status-active-brightgreen?style=flat-square) ![platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-Windows%2010%20%7C%2011-blue?style=flat-square) ![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-lightgrey?style=flat-square) ![build](https://img.shields.io/badge/build-passing-success?style=flat-square) ![version](https://img.shields.io/badge/release-v2.4.1-informational?style=flat-square)
**palette-from-image-ai** is a Windows desktop tool that reads any image — a screenshot, a photo, a game capture, a texture, a painting — and turns it into a usable color palette. Not five swatches scraped off a Wikipedia page either. The embedded vision model segments the image, clusters color by perceptual distance, weights each cluster by how much of the frame it actually owns, and emits a palette you can drop straight into a shader, a CSS file, an ASE swatch, a Godot theme, a clip-studio brush set, or a materials list. It runs offline. It runs on one `.exe`. You extract the archive, double-click, and you're looking at a palette in under six seconds. | Category | Details | |---|---| | **Product name** | palette-from-image-ai | | **Type** | Standalone Windows desktop application (`.exe`) | | **Core engine** | On-device vision model + perceptual color quantizer | | **Input** | PNG, JPG, WEBP, BMP, TIFF, GIF, AVIF | | **Output** | HEX, RGB, HSL, LAB, ASE, GPL, CSS vars, JSON, PNG swatch sheet | | **Distribution** | GitHub landing page → download → extract → run | | **Install footprint** | Portable. No installer, no registry writes, no runtime deps | | **Year** | 2026 release line | The whole point is that palette extraction stopped being a toy when the model got good at *understanding* what's in the frame. A sunset photo doesn't hand you four near-identical oranges anymore — it hands you the horizon glow, the deep water, the sand shadow, and the cloud highlight as separate, meaningful tones. --- ## 📖 What is palette-from-image-ai A glossary, because "palette" means different things to different people and this tool means all of them at once. | Term | Explanation | |---|---| | **Palette** | An ordered set of colors, usually 5–16, each with a role (dominant, accent, background, shadow, highlight). | | **Segmentation** | The model splitting an image into regions that *belong together* — sky vs. subject vs. ground — before sampling color. | | **Perceptual distance** | Measuring how different two colors look to a human eye, not how different their RGB numbers are. Uses CIEDE2000 in LAB space. | | **Cluster weight** | How much of the image a color family actually occupies, used to rank palette order. | | **Harmony mode** | Forcing the output toward a named scheme — analogous, complementary, triadic, or split-complement. | | **Role tagging** | Auto-labeling each swatch: this is the base, this is the accent, this is the dark you'll use for outlines. | | **Swatch sheet** | A rendered PNG of your palette with hex labels, ready to paste into a doc or Discord. | **What you get out of it:** - A palette that respects *regions*, not just raw pixel frequency. - Role-tagged swatches so you know which color does which job. - Harmony constraints when you want the output to look designed, not sampled. - Twelve export formats so the palette drops into whatever pipeline you already have. - The whole thing runs on your machine. No upload, no account, no network call. --- ## 🧩 Key Features | Feature | Description | Benefit | |---|---|---| | **Region-aware extraction** | Segments image, samples per region, merges perceptually | No more near-duplicate swatches | | **Perceptual clustering** | CIEDE2000 in LAB, not naive RGB k-means | Colors match what your eye sees | | **Role tagging** | Auto-labels base / accent / shadow / highlight | Skip the guesswork | | **Harmony constraints** | Analogous, complementary, triadic, split-comp | Palette looks intentional | | **12 export formats** | HEX, RGB, HSL, LAB, ASE, GPL, CSS, JSON, PNG, ACO, SKETCH, SVG | Fits any pipeline | | **Batch mode** | Drop a folder, get a palette per image | Whole asset packs in one pass | | **Palette diff** | Compare two palettes, see the delta | Track art-direction changes | | **Locked swatches** | Pin a color, re-extract the rest around it | Brand-color-safe | | **Eyeball sampler** | Click any pixel for exact value | Manual override always available | | **GPU toggle** | Optional DX12 acceleration for big images | 4K frame → palette in ~1.2s | | **Portable profile** | Settings live next to the `.exe` | Move it on a USB stick | | **No telemetry** | Zero outbound calls | Air-gap friendly | --- ## ⬇️ Download

--- ## 🧱 The Problem You've lived every one of these. - You grab a screenshot, run it through an online palette site, and get five colors that are all *the same orange* with different hex codes. - The palette ignores the one accent color that made the image interesting. - You need the palette in ASE for Photoshop and the site only gives you PNG. - The tool uploads your image to a server you've never heard of and you're now wondering who owns the render. - Your art director changes the sky and you have to re-extract the entire palette from scratch. - You're doing a whole asset pack — 40 sprites — and doing them one at a time on a website is a slow death. - The output has no roles, so you spend twenty minutes figuring out which swatch is "the dark one." --- ## 🛠️ The Solution | Problem | Solution | |---|---| | Near-duplicate swatches | Perceptual clustering in LAB, deduped by CIEDE2000 threshold | | Ignored accent colors | Region segmentation weights small-but-distinct regions higher | | Format lock-in | 12 export formats including ASE, GPL, ACO, CSS, JSON | | Uploaded images | Fully offline; no network code compiled in | | Re-extraction after edits | Locked swatches — pin what stays, re-derive the rest | | One-at-a-time workflows | Batch mode: whole folder, one palette each | | No role info | Auto role-tagging with editable labels | --- ## 🎯 Quick Start 1. 🗂️ **Extract the archive.** Right-click the downloaded `.zip`, choose *Extract All*, pick a folder you own (Documents or a tools directory is fine). 2. 🖱️ **Run the `.exe`.** Double-click it. Windows SmartScreen may show a warning on first run — click *More info* → *Run anyway*. No admin rights required. 3. 🖼️ **Drop an image in.** Drag any PNG/JPG/WEBP onto the window, or use *File → Open Image*. 4. 🎚️ **Tune the palette.** Slide the swatch count (5–16), pick a harmony mode if you want one, lock any color you want to keep. 5. 📤 **Export.** Hit *Export*, choose your format, done. Or right-click the swatch strip → *Copy as HEX*. That's the whole loop. First-run to exported palette is under a minute. --- ## 📦 Installation ### 1. Get the archive Use the download link above. You'll receive a `.zip` containing the `.exe` and a `models/` folder. Do not separate them — the vision model lives in `models/`. ### 2. Extract, don't run from inside the zip Running the `.exe` directly from the zip viewer will fail because the model files can't be memory-mapped from a compressed container. Extract the whole folder first. ### 3. First launch Double-click the `.exe`. On the first run, the app builds a small shader cache in `./cache/` — takes about 3 seconds. Every run after that is instant. No installer. No PATH changes. No Python. No Node. Delete the folder and it's fully uninstalled. --- ## 🖥️ System Requirements | Component | Minimum | Recommended | |---|---|---| | **OS** | Windows 10 21H2 (x64) | Windows 11 23H2+ (x64) | | **CPU** | 4-core, SSE4.2 | 8-core, AVX2 | | **RAM** | 4 GB | 16 GB | | **GPU** | Integrated (DX11) | Discrete DX12, 4 GB VRAM | | **Storage** | 450 MB free | 1.2 GB free (SSD) | | **Display** | 1280×720 | 1920×1080 or higher | | **Input** | Mouse + keyboard | + colorimeter (optional) | | **Runtime** | None | None | The app runs entirely CPU-side if you don't have a DX12 GPU. Expect ~5–8s per 4K image on CPU, ~1.2s with GPU acceleration enabled. --- ## 📊 Comparison | Aspect | Online palette sites | Generic k-means scripts | This Tool | |---|---|---|---| | Region awareness | No | No | Yes — segmentation-based | | Perceptual distance | Varies | Rarely | Yes — CIEDE2000 | | Offline | No | Yes | Yes | | Export formats | 2–4 | 1–2 | 12 | | Batch processing | Paid tiers only | Manual scripting | Built-in | | Swatch locking | No | No | Yes | | Harmony constraints | Sometimes | No | Yes — 4 modes | | Role tagging | No | No | Yes | | Speed (4K image) | N/A (upload) | 5–20s | ~1.2s (GPU) | --- ## 🧭 Feature Catalog 29 modules, grouped by what they actually do. ### 🎨 Extraction & Analysis - **Segmenter** — splits the image into semantically coherent regions before any sampling. - **Region Sampler** — pulls color within each region using a weighted grid, biased toward the region's center of mass. - **Perceptual Clusterer** — CIEDE2000 merge pass, collapses near-duplicates under a tunable threshold. - **Dominance Ranker** — orders swatches by area-weighted presence. - **Vibrance Detector** — identifies the most saturated region and flags it as a candidate accent. - **Shadow/Highlight Extractor** — pulls the darkest and brightest meaningful tones separately from the main run. ### 🎚️ Palette Control - **Swatch Count Slider** — 5 to 16 swatches, live-updating. - **Harmony Engine** — analogous, complementary, triadic, split-complement. Output is snapped to the scheme within tolerance. - **Swatch Lock** — pin any color; the rest get re-derived around it. - **Manual Eyeball Sampler** — click any pixel, get its exact value and add it as a swatch. - **Reorder Drag** — drag swatches to reorder; order is preserved on export. - **Role Tagger** — auto-assigns base / accent / shadow / highlight / neutral, editable per swatch. ### 📤 Export & Interop - **HEX / RGB / HSL / LAB Export** — plain text, one per line. - **ASE Export** — Adobe Swatch Exchange, drops into Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects. - **GPL Export** — GIMP / Inkscape palette files. - **ACO Export** — Photoshop legacy swatch format. - **CSS Variables Export** — `--color-1: #xxxxxx;` block, ready to paste. - **JSON Export** — structured with roles, weights, and hex. - **PNG Swatch Sheet** — rendered palette card with hex labels for docs and Discord. - **SVG Swatch Sheet** — vector version for print-ready docs. ### ⚙️ Workflow - **Batch Folder Mode** — point at a directory, get one palette per image. - **Palette Diff** — compare two palettes, see which swatches moved and by how much. - **Recent Palettes** — the last 20 palettes, restorable with one click. - **Preset Manager** — save harmony + count + threshold combos as named presets. - **Portable Profile** — everything lives in `./profile/`, next to the `.exe`. ### 🧪 Advanced - **GPU Acceleration Toggle** — DX12 compute path for large images. - **Custom Distance Function** — swap CIEDE2000 for CMC or CIE94 if you need it. - **Threshold Override** — expose the dedup threshold directly for finicky images. - **CLI Mode** — `.exe --input foo.png --count 8 --format css` for scripting. - **Watch Folder** — point it at a folder; new images get processed automatically. --- ## 🚦 All Modules Status | Module | Status | Description | |---|---|---| | Segmenter | ✅ Working | Region splitting on all supported formats | | Region Sampler | ✅ Working | Weighted-grid sampling per region | | Perceptual Clusterer | ✅ Working | CIEDE2000 merge, tunable threshold | | Dominance Ranker | ✅ Working | Area-weighted ordering | | Vibrance Detector | ✅ Working | Accent flagging | | Shadow/Highlight Extractor | ✅ Working | Boundary tone extraction | | Harmony Engine | ✅ Working | 4 named schemes | | Swatch Lock | ✅ Working | Pin-and-rederive | | Eyeball Sampler | ✅ Working | Per-pixel picker | | ASE Export | ✅ Working | Adobe Swatch Exchange v1.0 | | GPL Export | ✅ Working | GIMP palette format | | ACO Export | ✅ Working | Photoshop legacy swatches | | CSS Variables Export | ✅ Working | Ready-to-paste block | | JSON Export | ✅ Working | Role + weight + hex | | PNG Swatch Sheet | ✅ Working | Rendered card | | SVG Swatch Sheet | ✅ Working | Vector version | | Batch Folder Mode | ✅ Working | Multithreaded | | Palette Diff | ✅ Working | Delta report | | Preset Manager | ✅ Working | Named presets | | CLI Mode | ✅ Working | Scriptable | | Watch Folder | ✅ Working | Auto-process on file drop | | GPU Acceleration | ✅ Working | DX12 path | | Custom Distance Function | ✅ Working | CMC, CIE94, CIEDE2000 | | Threshold Override | ✅ Working | Exposed | | Role Tagger | ✅ Working | Editable labels | | Recent Palettes | ✅ Working | 20-item history | | Portable Profile | ✅ Working | Local config | | Reorder Drag | ✅ Working | Order preserved on export | | Swatch Count Slider | ✅ Working | 5–16 range | --- ## ⚠️ Known Issues | Issue | Solution | |---|---| | SmartScreen warning on first run | Click *More info* → *Run anyway*. The `.exe` is unsigned; a signed build is on the roadmap. | | Palette looks flat on highly saturated images | Lower the dedup threshold in *Settings → Advanced* to 2.0 and re-extract. | | Batch mode stalls on network drives | Copy images to a local folder first — the segmenter needs memory-mapped file access. | | ASE file not showing in Photoshop | Photoshop caches swatches. Restart Photoshop after importing. | | GPU toggle greyed out | Your GPU doesn't expose a DX12 compute queue. App runs CPU-only; no functional loss beyond speed. | | Very large TIFFs (>200 MP) fail to open | Downscale to under 100 MP first. The 16-bit TIFF path is on the roadmap. | --- ## ❔ FAQ | Question | Answer | |---|---| | Is it really offline? | Yes. No network code is compiled into the binary. You can run it with the Wi-Fi card disabled. | | Do I need an account? | No. There's no account system, no login, no telemetry. | | What formats can I feed it? | PNG, JPG, WEBP, BMP, TIFF, GIF, AVIF. Multi-frame GIFs use the first frame. | | Can I use it for commercial work? | Yes. MIT license. Attribution appreciated but not required. | | How many swatches should I pick? | 5 for minimalist UI, 8 for general art direction, 12–16 for full texture work. | | Why does the palette differ from a k-means script? | Perceptual distance + region segmentation. K-means on RGB treats two visually identical oranges as different colors. | | Can I script it? | Yes — CLI mode. `.exe --input foo.png --count 8 --format css --out palette.css`. | | Does it need admin rights? | No. Portable, user-space, no registry writes. | | Where are my settings saved? | `./profile/` next to the `.exe`, unless you point it elsewhere in *Settings → Storage*. | | Can I pin a brand color? | Yes — add the swatch, click the lock icon, re-extract. The rest of the palette re-derives around it. | | Why is the first launch slow? | Shader cache build. ~3 seconds once, instant after. | | Will there be a macOS or Linux build? | The engine is portable; a Linux CLI build is on the roadmap. macOS is unlikely due to the DX12 path. | --- ## 🧰 Usage Guidelines | Allowed | Not allowed | |---|---| | Personal art and design work | Redistributing the `.exe` under a different name | | Commercial projects (MIT) | Removing the license header from source | | Game asset pipelines | Selling the app as-is without modification | | Texture / shader authoring | Claiming authorship of the underlying vision model | | Educational use and research | Using it to scrape copyrighted images at scale | --- ## 🩹 Changelog - **v2.4.1** — Fixed ASE export on palettes with fewer than 6 swatches. Watch Folder now respects file locks. - **v2.4.0** — Added SVG swatch sheet export. GPU path is now default-on when a DX12 device is present. - **v2.3.2** — Region sampler no longer biases toward the frame center on wide-aspect images. - **v2.3.0** — Harmony Engine gained split-complement. CLI mode gained `--harmony` flag. --- ## 💡 Tips for Best Results - Give the segmenter a clean image. Cropped, well-lit source beats a cluttered screenshot every time. - If you want a specific color to survive extraction, lock it before you slide the swatch count. - For UI work, set count to 8 and pick *complementary* — the output tends to land as base/neutral/accent without further edits. - Batch mode is fastest on an SSD. Network drives add ~200ms per file in memory-mapped reads. - Use *Palette Diff* after an art-direction change to see exactly which tones moved. - Export to JSON if you're piping into a build step — it carries roles and weights, not just hex. - Lower the dedup threshold to 2.0 for photographic sources, 4.0 for flat-design or pixel art. - The eyeball sampler respects your monitor's ICC profile if *Settings → Color Management* is on. ---

palette-from-image-ai exists because palette extraction deserves the same seriousness as the rest of your pipeline. The model reads the image the way you read it — regions, meaning, weight — and hands you a palette you can actually ship. Extract the folder, run the `.exe`, drop an image in. The rest is five seconds of clicking and a color set you'll keep.

items.readme:
# 麦麦热量管家 · 味热比

**减脂不是少吃你爱的，是先换掉不值这口热量的。**

一个装进 AI 里的麦当劳 Skill。你告诉它今天吃了什么，麦当劳的按官方营养数据记，别的饭说一句就行；它算出这一顿还能吃多少，按你的口味和「味热比」排好一顿麦当劳，用官方接口核完价，等你说一句「下单」。

**[打开在线演示](https://wildernotrack.github.io/mcd-calorie-butler/)**：不用 Token，直接看它怎么调用麦当劳 MCP、怎么按味热比排一顿。

> 非麦当劳官方产品，由参赛者独立开发。内容仅供参考，不构成营养或医疗建议。

## 它干了什么

```
你：中午吃了食堂黄焖鸡米饭，还喝了杯半糖奶茶。晚上想吃麦当劳，帮我安排一下

管家：（调用麦当劳 MCP：now-time-info → list-nutrition-foods → query-nearby-stores
       → query-meals → query-meal-detail → calculate-price）

今天目标 1800 大卡：早餐 402（麦当劳，已记录），午餐约 950（估算），晚餐还剩 448 大卡。
你的老样子巨无霸三件套（949 大卡）放不下，我按味热比代价从小到大换：
· 可乐 → 纯牛奶：少 18 大卡，多 7g 蛋白质
· 巨无霸 → 麦乐鸡 5 块：少 300 大卡，代价 0.17
· 中薯条 → 小杯玉米杯：少 236 大卡，代价 1.36

麦乐鸡经典中套餐（小杯玉米杯 + 纯牛奶）
395 大卡 · 蛋白质 21g · ¥25.0（官方核价）· 福州路餐厅 19:00 到店取
也可以：板烧鸡腿堡三件套（玉米杯 + 无糖可乐，去冰 · 你说过一次）444 大卡 · ¥34.0

回复「下单」我就提交，付款在麦当劳官方页面完成。
```

上面每个数字都来自真实调用：热量来自 `list-nutrition-foods`，价格 ¥25.0 是 `calculate-price` 返回的 `"price":2500`（单位是分）。

## 和常见做法有什么不同

| | 常见的减脂点餐工具 | 麦麦热量管家 |
|---|---|---|
| 一天三顿 | 默认三顿都吃麦当劳 | 麦当劳只是其中一顿，别的饭说一句、AI 估算（标注"估算"） |
| 热量超了 | 推荐热量最低的 | 按**味热比**换：先换不值这口热量的，最爱的最后才动 |
| 口味 | 每次重新说 | **说一次就记住**：去酸黄瓜、可乐去冰，自动写进官方特调参数 |
| 老样子 | 不管 | 放得下就原样保留，放不下才改，每处改动都讲清楚为什么 |
| 数字 | 模型估或算 | 计算脚本算，`calculate-price` 核价；实测估算与官方核价一致 |
| 吃超了 | 建议下一顿少吃 | 不惩罚、不劝饿，给出最轻的选项和"明天再调整" |

## 味热比

**味热比 = 爱吃程度 ÷ 每百大卡热量。**

热量超了要换东西时，比的是**换掉它的代价**：少掉的爱吃程度 ÷ 少掉的热量。代价小的先换。所以可乐换无糖可乐（代价 0）最先，薯条换玉米杯（代价 1.36）最后——薯条是大众最爱，换掉最心疼。

爱吃程度先用大众口味作默认值（来源：[麦购网「麦当劳十大最受欢迎产品」综合指数](https://www.maigoo.com/top/424487.html)，汇总了大众点评、美团、饿了么的评价与热销情况），榜单外的餐品给中间值 6.0；用户可以随时改，常点的会自动加分。

按大众口味算，**圆筒冰淇淋是麦当劳最值这口热量的（8.9），麦辣鸡腿汉堡和巨无霸最不值（约 1.7）**。

详见 [味热比](skill/mcd-calorie-butler/references/weirebi.md)。

## 怎么用

### 1. 申请麦当劳 MCP Token

在 [open.mcd.cn/mcp](https://open.mcd.cn/mcp) 登录后申请。把 Token 放进环境变量，**不要**写进任何文件或发给别人：

```bash
export MCD_MCP_TOKEN="你的 Token"          # PowerShell：$env:MCD_MCP_TOKEN="你的 Token"
```

### 2. 在 AI 客户端里连上麦当劳 MCP

参考 [mcp-config.example.json](mcp-config.example.json)。WorkBuddy：左侧【专家·技能·连接器】→【连接器】→【自定义连接器】→【配置MCP】，填入配置并把 `${MCD_MCP_TOKEN}` 换成你的 Token。Claude Code、Cursor、Cherry Studio 同理。

### 3. 安装 Skill

```bash
python install.py --target workbuddy     # 复制到 ~/.workbuddy/skills/mcd-calorie-butler
python install.py --target claude        # 复制到 ~/.claude/skills/mcd-calorie-butler
```

也可以在 WorkBuddy 的技能页上传 `skill/mcd-calorie-butler` 文件夹。需要 Python 3.9+，无第三方依赖。

### 4. 开始

对 AI 说"我在减脂，帮我建个档"，它会问目标、口味、常去的店和老样子。之后每天说"中午吃了……""晚上吃什么麦当劳"就行。

## 不用 Token 先看看

```bash
python -m unittest discover -s tests -v   # 14 个离线测试，用录制的真实 MCP 返回
python tools/demo_server.py               # 打开 http://127.0.0.1:8765 看交互演示
```

演示页的排餐算法与 Skill 的计算脚本是同一套，数据是录制的真实菜单与营养表。本机配置了 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` 时，演示页的午饭可以随便输入，由大模型估算；Key 只在本地服务端读取。

也可以直接跑计算脚本：

```bash
cd skill/mcd-calorie-butler
python scripts/butler.py nutrition load ../../tests/fixtures/nutrition.txt
python scripts/butler.py profile set --goal-kcal 1800 --protein 90
python scripts/butler.py base set --code 9900005466 --name 巨无霸三件套
python scripts/butler.py taste add 去酸黄瓜
python scripts/butler.py plan --meal dinner --budget-kcal 448 --meals ../../tests/fixtures/meals.txt --details ../../tests/fixtures/detail_*.txt
python scripts/butler.py love show --known-only --top 10
```

## 它怎么工作

```
你 ──说话──▶ AI（WorkBuddy / Claude / Cursor）
              ├─ 读 Skill：流程、规则、方案卡格式（SKILL.md + references/）
              ├─ 调麦当劳 MCP：营养表、门店、菜单、套餐换配、计价、下单
              └─ 跑计算脚本：记账、剩余热量、味热比、排餐、口味特调、分↔元
```

- **麦当劳 MCP** 只负责取数和下单，详见 [MCP_INTEGRATION.md](MCP_INTEGRATION.md)。
- **计算脚本** `scripts/butler.py` 负责所有数字，模型不心算。
- **AI** 负责听懂你、估算非麦当劳食物、把结果讲清楚。

## 适合谁

- 在减脂、控卡或增肌，但不想和麦当劳绝交的人
- 想吃得心里有数、又懒得每顿查热量表的上班族和学生
- 想和对象/朋友一起点，但各自目标不同的人（[一起吃](skill/mcd-calorie-butler/references/together.md)）

## 健康与隐私

- 每日目标不低于基础代谢（女性不低于 1200、男性不低于 1500 大卡），设得更低会被提到下限。
- 吃超了照实记，不劝饿、不评价身材；提到疾病、孕期等情况会建议咨询医生或营养师。详见 [健康边界](skill/mcd-calorie-butler/references/health.md)。
- 饮食日记、口味、爱吃程度只存在本机 `~/.mcd-calorie-butler/`。仓库里没有任何 Token 或个人信息。
- 只有你明确说"下单"才会调用 `create-order`；不会自动领券、抽奖、兑换或取消订单。

## 目录

```
skill/mcd-calorie-butler/      Skill 本体（装进 AI 客户端的就是这个文件夹）
  SKILL.md                     主流程
  references/                  味热比、MCP 调用手册、估算规范、健康边界、一起吃
  scripts/butler.py            计算脚本（纯标准库）
  data/public_love.json        大众口味默认值及来源
tests/                         离线测试 + 录制的真实 MCP 返回（tests/fixtures）
tools/                         录制数据、导出演示数据、本地演示服务
docs/                          交互演示页
workbuddy.md                   在腾讯 WorkBuddy 里调研、安装、真机联调的记录
```

## 许可

MIT。参赛声明见 [CONTEST_DECLARATION.md](CONTEST_DECLARATION.md)。

items.readme:
# GPTibo

可自托管的商城前台、管理后台、代理工作台及主站后端。前端使用 React、TypeScript 和 Vite；主后端使用 Go、Gin 与 PostgreSQL，同时保留 Cloudflare Workers + D1 实现。

这是经过脱敏的独立开源版本，使用 MIT 许可证。上游供应商和聚合支付通道已匿名化，接入地址使用保留域名 `example.invalid`，商户身份、密钥、授权商品映射和生产部署资料不随源码提供。接口适配器保留为开发参考，需要自行实现或核对协议；**不是填入原商户密钥即可上线的生产副本**。支付宝官方公开协议示例保留，真实支付、采购及通知默认关闭。

## 包含内容

- 商品展示、订单查询、售后、邮件模板和多语言界面。
- 管理员及代理工作台、商品定价、订单、客户、退款和结算管理。
- Go API、业务 Worker、数据库迁移、鉴权、交易状态机及回归测试。
- Cloudflare Worker / D1 备用实现与本地开发配置。

不包含生产数据、生产配置、历史 Git 提交、运营截图、独立供货平台和内部运维工具。数据库结构、配置名和部分路由已匿名化：仅使用新建的开发数据库，不可直接升级已有生产库。示例金额和商品仅用于演示，不构成报价。

## 前端开发

需要 Node.js 22.18+（推荐 24）、npm 和 Python 3。

```sh
npm ci
npm run dev
npm run build
npm test
npm run lint
npm run security:scan
```

默认 Vite 地址为 `http://127.0.0.1:5173`，API 代理至本地 Worker 8787。接 Go 后端时改用：

```sh
npx vite --config services/storefront/vite.config.ts
```

此时前端在 `http://127.0.0.1:5175`，API 代理至 Go 的 8093 端口。管理员入口 `/admin`，代理入口 `/partner`。空库和未配置身份时，相关功能不可用。

## Go 后端

见 [后端运行说明](services/storefront/README.md)。需要 Go 1.26+ 和独立 PostgreSQL 数据库，或使用 Docker Compose。默认不启用邮件和任何真实交易渠道。

```sh
cd services/storefront
go test ./...
go vet ./...
```

未设置 `STOREFRONT_TEST_DATABASE_URL` 时，PostgreSQL 集成测试会跳过；完整验收必须设置本机、库名以 `_test` 结尾的专用数据库连接。

## Cloudflare 本地运行

```sh
cp .dev.vars.example .dev.vars
npx wrangler d1 migrations apply gptibo-local --local
npm run preview:worker
```

`.dev.vars` 仅保存在本机。管理员需要自行设置 `ADMIN_USERNAME`、`ADMIN_EMAIL` 和独立的 Base32 `ADMIN_TOTP_SECRET`；邮件验证还需要邮件服务凭据和认证密钥，空配置不会启用登录。示例中的认证秘密不能复用测试向量。

仓库没有一键生产部署命令。`wrangler.jsonc` 不绑定任何生产账号/域名，数据库 ID 是全零占位值。若自行部署，先创建自己的资源、注入独立秘密、完成迁移并验证隔离和交易流程。

## 接入与安全

- `recharge`：匿名充值适配器。
- `account_supplier`、`delivery_supplier`：匿名采购适配器。
- `gatewaya`、`gatewayb`：匿名聚合支付协议示例。
- `xgift`：商城侧赠送接口适配器，不包含供应商执行系统。

所有回调、金额、签名、商户归属和幂等校验仍然保留。匿名地址和演示映射不对应可用服务；需要按自己的服务重新适配。前端变量不得存放服务器秘密。

发布检查及报告见 [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) 和 [OPEN_SOURCE_REVIEW.md](OPEN_SOURCE_REVIEW.md)。第三方图标、字体和样式遵循各自许可证；MIT 授权不转授第三方商标和美术作品权利，详见 `public/brands/` 和 `src/styles/vendor/`。

items.description: 套餐拼图 · 把每个人想吃的拼成一桌：真实麦当劳菜单、心愿组合、官方核价与按人分餐。
items.readme:
真实菜单 · 官方核价 · 按人分餐

一起吃麦当劳，有人想喝咖啡，有人想吃汉堡，还有人只想分一份薯条。套餐拼图收集每个人的心愿，从门店当前菜单中组合套餐和单品，调用麦当劳 MCP 核清价格，再把餐品分到各人的餐盘。 适合 **1–6 位朋友、同事或家人**一起商量到店自取餐单：一人操作，大家一起选。 [本地运行](#立即在本地使用) · [真实案例](#一桌早餐怎么拼) · [MCP 接入](MCP_INTEGRATION.md) · [参赛记录](SUBMISSION.md) ![换好饮品、按三人心愿分配后的餐桌](docs/screenshots/02-table.jpg) ## 从心愿到餐桌 1. **选餐厅，填心愿。** 选择附近门店，为每个人填写想吃的品类与份数，也可以设置整桌预算。 2. **看看可以怎么拼。** 比较最多 3 个已核价方案：多少钱、满足几份心愿、还缺什么、多出什么，连同优惠条件一起看清楚。 3. **换成喜欢的搭配。** 选中方案后，可以换饮品、换小食，再获取官方核价。未变餐品保留原来的分配。 4. **分好，带走餐单。** 按心愿分到各人餐盘，多余餐品留在分享区；支持手动调整，最后复制或下载带门店、选配、归属和核价时间的清单。 ## 一桌早餐怎么拼 三位搭子，七份心愿： | 搭子 | 想吃什么 | | --- | --- | | 阿橙 | 早餐堡/卷 ×1、薯饼 ×1、咖啡 ×1 | | 小蓝 | 早餐堡/卷 ×1、咖啡 ×1 | | 小满 | 粥 ×1、薯饼 ×1 | 套餐拼图生成了三桌方案，并逐桌向官方核价： ![三组真实核价方案，均满足七份心愿](docs/screenshots/01-plans.jpg) 其中一桌是 **吉士蛋麦满分套餐 ×2 + 粥王系列精选 ×1**，当次核价 **¥41.50**，满足 **7/7 份心愿**，额外 **0 份**。选中后，三人的餐盘分别分到 3、2、2 份。 随后把两份套餐的饮品换成冰美式，重新核价为 **¥49.50**，再按心愿分好，就是上方餐桌截图中的结果。 以上为 **2026-10-13 上海黄浦华旭国际大厦餐厅**的真实验收记录。餐品与价格随门店、供应时段和权益变化；完整过程见[验收记录](docs/VERIFICATION.md)。 ## 立即在本地使用 准备 **Node.js 22+**。项目无第三方运行依赖，无需 `npm install`。 ```sh git clone https://github.com/jumpersun/meal-puzzle.git cd meal-puzzle cp .env.example .env ``` 按[官方 MCP 接入指引](https://github.com/M-China/mcd-mcp-server)申请 Token，在本机 `.env` 的 `MCD_MCP_TOKEN=` 后填入并保存，然后启动： ```sh npm start ``` 打开 **[http://127.0.0.1:4317](http://127.0.0.1:4317)**，选择餐厅，点击“填入示例心愿”，再点“帮我们拼一桌”。示例会根据当前早餐或非早餐菜单切换。 Token 仅由服务端读取，`.env` 已被 Git 忽略。默认位置为可修改的“上海人民广场”；端口占用时可用 `PORT=4318 npm start`。 **无 Token 体验：** 保留 `.env` 中的空值，启动后打开[趣味演示](http://127.0.0.1:4317/demo.html)，体验拼餐、分餐和清单交互。演示使用虚构菜单与示例价格，真实菜单和官方核价需配置 Token。 ## 怎么把这桌拼出来 前端收集结构化心愿，服务端通过四个麦当劳 MCP 工具获取真实数据： | 环节 | MCP Tool | 用途 | | --- | --- | --- | | 找餐厅 | `query-nearby-stores` | 查询附近门店 | | 看菜单 | `query-meals` | 获取当前餐品、商品图、展示价与优惠标记 | | 选搭配 | `query-meal-detail` | 读取套餐选项、默认搭配与数量规则 | | 核价格 | `calculate-price` | 获取整桌实际报价 | 规划器最多读取 20 款相关产品的详情，组合候选并核价，再按**心愿满足度、实际总价、额外份数**排序，展示最多 3 桌。组合与分配由 JavaScript 完成，无需额外大模型或提示词。 菜单中的购卡条件价、促销标记与本次核价分别展示，方便判断优惠是否适用于这一桌。商品图片按官方编码对应，缺图时显示“暂无图片”。调用流程、参数校验与部署要求见 [MCP_INTEGRATION.md](MCP_INTEGRATION.md)。 ## 使用说明 - **心愿范围**：支持鸡肉堡/卷、牛肉堡、薯条、麦乐鸡、可乐、咖啡、早餐堡/卷、薯饼、粥，共 9 类；每人每类最多 3 份，整桌最多 18 份。具体品名、冷热与杯型可在方案详情确认。 - **预算与选方案**：预算用于显示余量或超出金额，缺少和多出的餐品会明确列出。推荐来自有限候选范围，不保证全菜单最低价。 - **价格有效期**：改餐、换门店或刷新菜单后需重新核价。报价快照展示 2 分钟，到期隐藏金额并提示刷新；该时长为应用展示规则。 - **使用方式**：由一人在本机操作和记录餐盘确认，刷新页面会清空当前餐桌。支持到店自取餐单整理，采用门店默认特调；下单与支付需在官方渠道完成。 ## 开发与验证 原生 JavaScript 前端 + Node.js 服务端，另提供 Worker 适配层。 | 代码 | 职责 | | --- | --- | | [`public/wish-planner.js`](public/wish-planner.js) | 心愿匹配、候选生成、按人分餐 | | [`public/wishes.js`](public/wishes.js) / [`public/live.js`](public/live.js) | 心愿与方案界面、菜单、换搭配、餐单分享 | | [`server/api.mjs`](server/api.mjs) | MCP 会话、参数校验、候选核价与整单核价 | | [`server.mjs`](server.mjs) / [`worker/index.js`](worker/index.js) | 本地服务与 Worker 运行入口 | ```sh # 真实菜单与拼餐流程的相关测试 node --test tests/live.test.mjs tests/planner.test.mjs # JavaScript 语法检查 npm run check ``` 已有真实接口、桌面与移动端验收记录，详见 [docs/VERIFICATION.md](docs/VERIFICATION.md)。 ## 文档与参赛 - [MCP 接入说明](MCP_INTEGRATION.md)与[脱敏配置示例](mcp-config.example.json) - [参赛提交材料与演示脚本](SUBMISSION.md) - [官方参赛声明](CONTEST_DECLARATION.md) - [参赛 Issue #592](https://github.com/M-China/mcd-developer-innovation-challenge/issues/592)与[官方成功确认](https://github.com/M-China/mcd-developer-innovation-challenge/issues/592#issuecomment-6137220793) 本项目为独立参赛作品，非麦当劳官方产品。原创代码采用 [MIT License](LICENSE)；商品图片、商标及官方声明的权利范围见[素材说明](ASSETS.md)。

# 方块羊城 · Block Guangzhou

> **Minecraft 方块风格 + GTA 城市漫游 + 宝可梦拍照收集** 的广州城市观光模拟器
> 无需出门，在浏览器里逛广州：自由行走、探索景点、拍照打卡、收集图鉴、体验羊城昼夜与四季烟火。

基于 **Vue 3 + Three.js (WebGL)** 实现，按 [prd.md](./prd.md) 产品需求文档开发，纯前端运行、无需服务器。

---

## ✨ 核心特色

- 🏙️ **还原广州城市格局** — 真实经纬度投影（现实 1km ≈ 游戏 200 格），7 大城区 + 珠江水系 + 方块化地形
- 📷 **摄影收集玩法** — 多视角相机 + 滤镜 + 自动识别景点，拍满图鉴做"羊城旅行家"
- 🚇 **城市生活模拟** — 巴士、地铁传送、珠江夜游、广州塔电梯、白云索道、路人 NPC、早茶烧腊
- 🌗 **昼夜与天气** — 晴/阴/雨/台风随机变化，夜晚广州塔灯光秀与珠江实时倒影

# pLinux5-NG

boot linux on PS5 consoles running high firmware (8.xx through 13.60) 

this project is a port/rework of the existing [ps5-linux-loader](https://github.com/ps5-linux/ps5-linux-loader) 
(which currently works on 3.00 though 7.61) to the new [byepervisor-reborn](https://github.com/PS5Dev/Byepervisor-Reborn) hypervisor escape 

- the linux boot pat itself (bzImage/initrd relocation, `boot_params`/e820 setup,
  hardware bring up, SVM/IOMMU teardown, the jump to `startup_64`) is brought over
  from the existing ps5-linux-loader
- the **escape* -- how we get code running in hypervisor root mode on all cores on high firmware --
  is what has changed in this project. on 3.00 through 7.61 its flatz' ACPI-wakeup ROP
  chain; on high firmware it is a khook on the S3-resume `HV_MP_STARTUP_CALL` path. as implemented
  in Byepervisor-Reborn.

## usage

### **CRITICAL** 
ps5 configuration:
  enable rest mode features:
    `settings` -> `system` -> `power saving` -> `features available in rest mode`, set `Supply Power to USB Ports` to `Always`
  disable HDMI device link:
    `settings` -> `system` -> `HDMI`, set `Enable HDMI Device Link` to be `off` 
  

# installation

follow [ps5-linux-loader installation](https://github.com/ps5-linux/ps5-linux-loader#installation) until you get to
step 4, then come back here.

### running the jailbreak

- set your playstations DNS under:
  `settings` -> `network` -> `settings` -> `set up internet connection` then click the `options` button on
  your controller, then select `advanced settings`, from there set `primary DNS` to `45.56.67.85` then select `ok`
  ***you will get a popup saying `internet connection failed`, thats good, continue.***

- navigate to the users guide:
  `settings` -> `Guide & Tips, Health and Safety, and Other Information` -> `User's Guide`.
   when a popup appears saying: `the secuirty of the page can't be confirmed...`, click `yes`

    you should end up in a page with big letters saying `RELAPSE`, click the `Jailbreak` button & wait for it to finish
    it finishing will be marked by elfldr starting.
now download the `pLinux5-NG.elf` from releases, or see [building](#building) to build from source, then move to [sending](###sending)

### sending

on linux/unix, use:
```bash
# (from the area with the repo + pLinux5-NG.elf) 
cd scripts/
chmod +x send.sh
./send.sh PS5_IP=<Playstation 5s IP> PS5_PORT=9021 pLinux5-NG.elf
```




# building
Requires the [PS5 payload SDK](https://github.com/ps5-payload-dev/sdk) and the
pLabs5 host toolchain override:

```bash
export PS5_PAYLOAD_SDK=/path/to/ps5-payload-sdk
export LLVM_CONFIG=/path/to/pLabs5-SDK/tools/nixos/llvm-config
make -j
```

The output is `bin/pLinux5-NG.elf`.

The shellcode blobs are compiled freestanding with the host `gcc`
(`-ffreestanding -nostdlib`) and embedded as C headers; `scripts/bin2c.py`
replaces `xxd -i`, which is not present in every environment.

## Sending

```bash
socat -t 99999999 - TCP:$PS5IP:9021 < bin/pLinux5-NG.elf
# or
nc -N $PS5IP 9021 < bin/pLinux5-NG.elf
```

## License

The project is licensed under the **AGPL-3.0** (see [`LICENSE`](LICENSE)).
The boot path and shellcode are derived from **ps5-linux-loader**, which is
**GPL-3.0**; those files retain their original authorship and are used here in
accordance with the GPL/AGPL compatibility provisions. The high-firmware escape
is adapted from **Byepervisor-Reborn**. See [`PORTING.md`](PORTING.md#credits).

# ResumeBuilder · 简历生成器

纯前端、零后端的本地简历生成器，支持浅色 / 深色主题，所有数据保存在浏览器 `localStorage`，完全离线可用。

## 功能特性

- **八步内容编辑**：基本信息、教育经历、实习经历、项目经历、实践经历、技能、爱好、自定义栏目，边写边预览。
- **本地自动保存**：编辑内容自动存入浏览器，刷新不丢失；支持导入 / 导出 JSON 备份与迁移。
- **主题与壁纸**：浅色 / 深色双主题；壁纸支持内置极光动画、内置渐变或自定义图片，均离线可用。
- **单文件运行**：打包为无控制台 EXE，启动后常驻系统托盘，右键可「打开 / 退出」，不弹黑框。

items.name: kybes
items.description: Know Your Backend is a Plugin that help your AI to generate a structured Model/View/Controller application, witouth surprise, code duplication and different modality in a different project
items.readme:
# kybes — Know Your Backend **kybes is a Claude Code plugin that makes AI-generated backends predictable.** Every project gets the same folders, the same file names and the same data-access methods. There is no duplicated code, and every rule that can be checked automatically is enforced as a hook or a CI step, not left to a prompt. > After a million lines of generated code across different projects, you should still know without searching that `src/model/Clienti.cs` holds the CRUD, relations and custom queries of the `Clienti` table. kybes makes that true. --- ## Why Asking an AI to "follow our architecture" works only some of the time. Instructions get lost when the context grows. Planners and subagents may never see them. Two runs of the same prompt produce two different layouts. kybes takes a different approach: | Problem | What kybes does | |---|---| | Repetitive code written differently each time | A **deterministic generator** writes it from a YAML schema, byte-identical across projects | | Rules forgotten by planners and subagents | Rules are **preloaded into dedicated agents** and **loaded per folder** | | Rules ignored under pressure | **Hooks** reject non-compliant writes and **block completion** until checks pass | | Code duplicated across services | A **duplicate-code gate** fails the work, and the fix is always to extract | | Slow queries discovered in production | Every declared access path gets a **covering index**, computed automatically | ## How it works ```mermaid flowchart LR S["schemas/db/Clienti.yaml
columns · relations · queries
pagination · transactions
tenancy · archive"] --> G{{"kybes generator
deterministic"}} G --> CS["C# · EF Core 8
model/Clienti.cs"] G --> PY["Python · SQLAlchemy 2
model/Clienti.py"] G --> TS["TypeScript · TypeORM
model/Clienti.ts"] G --> JV["Java · JPA / Hibernate 6
model/ClientiRepository.java"] G --> JS["JSON Schema
API Gateway validation"] G --> DDL["PostgreSQL DDL
+ index analysis"] G --> JOB["archive & TTL jobs
Parquet · K8s · Athena"] G --> IDX["MODEL_INDEX.md
where everything is"] ``` For each table, every language gets two files: - `model/generated/` holds the entity, CRUD, relations, declared queries, cursor pagination and validation. It is **regenerated** and nobody edits it. - `model/
` is the **only** place for custom methods of that table. In C# it is a `partial class`; in the other languages it is a subclass. ### Life of a change with Claude Code ```mermaid sequenceDiagram autonumber actor Dev as You participant A as kybes:architect participant I as kybes:implementer participant H as kybes hooks participant R as kybes:reviewer Dev->>A: "Add suppliers, linked to products" A-->>Dev: plan — schema changes, runtimes, reused & new methods Dev->>I: implement task 1 I->>H: Write schemas/db/Fornitori.yaml H-->>I: ✓ model regenerated in 4 languages, index updated I->>H: Write a query with SQLAlchemy inside a Lambda H-->>I: ✗ denied — data access only through the model I->>H: Write custom method in model/Fornitori.py H-->>I: ✓ allowed (name doesn't collide with generated methods) I->>R: done R-->>Dev: independent review against the checklist Note over H: Stop gate: arch_check + gen --check + tests must pass,
otherwise the agent cannot finish ``` ## A schema in, the same API out ```yaml # schemas/db/Ordini.yaml table: Ordini columns: - { name: Id, type: uuid, primary_key: true } - { name: Numero, type: string, length: 20, required: true, unique: true } - { name: ClienteId, type: uuid, required: true } - { name: Data, type: date, required: true } relations: - { name: Cliente, kind: many_to_one, target: Clienti, foreign_key: ClienteId } queries: - name: DelClienteDal where: [ClienteId, { column: Data, op: gte, param: DaData }] order_by: [{ column: Data, dir: desc }] pagination: default_order: [{ column: Data, dir: desc }] sortable: [Data, Numero] ``` | Generated method | C# | Python | TypeScript / Java | |---|---|---|---| | read by key | `GetByIdAsync` | `get_by_id` | `getById` | | cursor page, UI-selectable sort | `ListPageAsync` | `list_page` | `listPage` | | create / update / delete (validated) | `CreateAsync` … | `create` … | `create` … | | by unique column | `FindByNumeroAsync` | `find_by_numero` | `findByNumero` | | page by foreign key | `ListByClienteIdAsync` | `list_by_cliente_id` | `listByClienteId` | | parent of a relation | `GetClienteAsync` | `get_cliente` | `getCliente` | | declared query | `ListDelClienteDalAsync` | `list_del_cliente_dal` | `listDelClienteDal` | The generator also creates the index `(ClienteId, Data)` that covers both `listByClienteId` and `DelClienteDal`, and records the decision in `db/generated/indexes.md`. ## Features | Area | What you get | Status | |---|---|---| | **Data model** | entities, CRUD, relations (incl. hierarchies), validation and default values in C#, Python, TypeScript and Java | ✅ available | | **Declared queries** | `eq`, `ne`, `lt`…`gte`, `in`, `prefix` (LIKE-safe), `is_null`; returning a page, a list or one row | ✅ available | | **Index analysis** | ideal index per access path; missing indexes created, redundant ones flagged; `varchar_pattern_ops` for prefix search | ✅ available | | **Cursor pagination** | keyset `PageRequest → Page {items, nextCursor}` from UI to DB; cursor format identical across languages | ✅ available | | **Transactions** | Unit of Work with per-table isolation level and automatic retry on serialization failures and deadlocks | ✅ available | | **PostgreSQL DDL** | complete schema with constraints and indexes, validated by the PostgreSQL parser | ✅ available | | **Guardrail hooks** | data access outside the model, generated files, folder layout, method collisions, secrets, duplicates | ✅ available | | **Unit tests to ISO 26262-6** | requirement IDs and test cases derived from each schema (requirements analysis, equivalence classes, boundary values, error guessing, MC/DC for ASIL C/D); runnable pytest and node:test suites; traceability matrix; coverage gate per table ASIL; mandatory traced tests for custom methods | ✅ available | | **Multi-tenancy** | per table: tenant column (every method filtered, unique constraints per tenant, PostgreSQL row-level security), schema per tenant, or database per tenant; tenant bound to the ORM session; generated isolation tests | ✅ available | | **Hot/cold archive** | old rows move to Parquet on S3/Azure Blob, partitioned by tenant and date; every file is verified (rows, keys, SHA-256) before the rows leave the hot table, and an interrupted move is completed by the next run; `getById` can read through to the archive in all four languages; Athena tables and Synapse views generated | ✅ available | | **Retention (TTL)** | archive partitions or hot rows deleted after a declared age; jobs as Kubernetes CronJob, KEDA ScaledJob triggered by backlog, or 24/7 engine; one job engine with its own generated tests | ✅ available | | **MongoDB** | same repository interface over MongoDB in all four languages | 🗺️ planned | ## Guardrails | When | Check | Default | |---|---|---| | before every write | ORM or DB driver imported outside the model (all 4 languages) | block | | before every write | edits to generated files, JSON Schemas, DDL, generated jobs, `MODEL_INDEX.md` | block | | before every write | a file in `model/` that doesn't map to a table, or a sub-folder | block | | before every write | a custom method named like a generated one | block | | before every write | secrets in clear text (AWS keys, private keys, tokens, passwords) | block | | before finishing | a custom model method without a traced test (`TC-
-…`) in `tests/custom/` | block | | after every write | schema saved → model regenerated in every language; linters; architecture warnings | — | | before finishing (main agent and every subagent) | `arch_check` (incl. duplicated blocks of 8+ lines), `gen --check`, `verify.py` (model tests + coverage per ASIL), your test commands | block | | in CI | the same checks, `--strict` | fail build | Every rule can be set to `block`, `warn` or `off` in `.claude/kybes.config.json`, a file the agent is not allowed to modify. ## Predictable layout ```text your-project/ ├── schemas/ │ ├── db/
.yaml ← yours: the single source of truth │ └── generated/json/
.schema.json ├── libs/db-models//…/model/ │ ├──
.{cs,py,ts} |
Repository.java ← yours: custom methods only │ └── generated/ ← generator only ├── libs/db-models//tests/ │ ├── generated/ ← ISO 26262-6 unit tests, generator only │ └── custom/ ← yours: tests of your custom methods ├── docs/generated/verification/ ← requirements, test specs, traceability, coverage policy ├── db/generated/ddl/postgres/_all.sql ← DDL, indexes.md ├── db/generated/{athena,synapse}/ ← queries over the Parquet archive ├── jobs/generated/
-archive/ ← job config + Kubernetes manifest (CronJob, KEDA, Deployment) ├── jobs/generated/_engine/ ← archive & TTL job engine with its tests and Dockerfile ├── services//{functions,ms}/ ← Lambda / Kubernetes handlers ├── jobs/ libs/utils/ libs/errors/ frontend/ infra/ ├── MODEL_INDEX.md ← tables → files → methods └── .claude/kybes.config.json ``` **The rule:** everything under a `generated/` folder belongs to the generator; everything else is yours. ## Install **From Claude Code (marketplace):** ```text /plugin marketplace add ivandilelio/kybes /plugin install kybes@kybes ``` Then, inside a project, ask Claude *"set up kybes in this project"*. This runs the `kybes:kybes-init` skill, which asks for the model languages and creates the configuration, path rules, the CLAUDE.md block, an optional scaffold and the CI workflow. The hooks stay inactive in repositories that have not been set up. **From the command line:** ```bash git clone https://github.com/ivandilelio/kybes kybes/install.sh --target /path/to/project --scaffold --examples \ --model-langs csharp,python,typescript,java ``` The installer is idempotent. Teammates run `tools/kybes/setup.sh` once after cloning the project. ### Requirements | Generated code | Needs | |---|---| | C# | `net8.0`, Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore 8 and a provider (e.g. Npgsql) | | Python | Python 3.9+, SQLAlchemy 2 | | TypeScript | TypeORM, `reflect-metadata`, `experimentalDecorators` and `emitDecoratorMetadata` | | Java | Jakarta Persistence 3.1, Hibernate 6.2+, Jackson for `json` columns | | archive jobs | Python 3.10+, SQLAlchemy 2, pyarrow, psycopg 3; boto3 or azure-storage-blob (all in the generated `pyproject.toml` and `Dockerfile`) | | hooks and generator | `python3` (standard library only) | ## How kybes itself is verified `tests/run.sh` installs kybes into throw-away projects and checks the generated code: | | Verification | |---|---| | Python | real CRUD, relations, cascades, unique constraints, pagination edge cases (ties, tampered cursors, disallowed sorts), every query operator, and Unit of Work commit, rollback and retry, on SQLite | | TypeScript | the same scenarios on sql.js; `strict` + `noUnusedLocals` compilation for the PostgreSQL dialect | | Generated tests | the ISO 26262-6 suites generated into the sample project run green in all four languages (Python and TypeScript also on PostgreSQL), within the ASIL coverage thresholds; mutants (dropped query condition, off-by-one length or page limit, flipped keyset comparator, retry off-by-one) are killed | | Java | `javac -Xlint:all -Werror` against faithful JPA/Hibernate stubs locally; in CI the generated JUnit 5 suite runs on Hibernate 6 and PostgreSQL 16, with JaCoCo coverage within the ASIL thresholds | | C# | tree-sitter syntax check locally; in CI the model builds with `-warnaserror` and the generated xUnit suite runs on EF Core 8 and PostgreSQL 16, with coverlet coverage within the ASIL thresholds | | SQL | generated DDL parsed by the PostgreSQL parser (`pglast`); in CI row-level security, schema and database per tenant run on PostgreSQL 16 | | Archive jobs | the engine's own suite at 100% branch coverage on SQLite and PostgreSQL; a real job run through the CLI (move, child kept, retention, read-through from the Python model); Parquet layout read by DuckDB; S3 via moto and Azure Blob via Azurite; Kubernetes manifests parsed; the RLS check against a role without `BYPASSRLS` | | Cross-language | a cursor produced by TypeScript, Python or Java is accepted by the others | | Hooks | every rule with its expected outcome (deny/allow), auto-regeneration, duplicate detection, stop gate | ## Documentation The detailed documentation is in Italian, in [`docs/`](docs/README.md): - [architecture](docs/architettura.md) - [folder map](docs/struttura-cartelle.md) - [schema reference](docs/schema-yaml.md) - [generator](docs/generatore.md) - [queries & indexes](docs/query-e-indici.md) - [pagination](docs/paginazione.md) - [transactions](docs/transazioni.md) - [guardrails](docs/controlli.md) - [multi-tenancy](docs/multi-tenant.md) - [archive & retention](docs/archivio.md) - [unit verification (ISO 26262-6)](docs/verifica.md) - [configuration](docs/configurazione.md) - [roadmap](docs/roadmap.md) - [developing the kit](docs/sviluppo.md) ## A note on ISO 26262 kybes automates the part of ISO 26262-6 that can be automated at software-unit level: requirement-based test derivation, structural coverage criteria per ASIL, and bidirectional traceability. Compliance is still a property of your whole development process (safety plan, hazard analysis, tool qualification, independent reviews), and certification remains your organisation's step. ## Author Ivan Di Lelio · [Meta Innovation](https://www.metainnovation.it)
